summary: Tested the new 'Remedial (Pre Basic)' pricing tier and both lead-capture flows end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (6/6 passing) covers /api/plan-selection and /api/contact including validation. Frontend Playwright run verified: all 6 pricing rows render in the correct order with correct Remedial content, Choose button opens the plan dialog with 'Remedial (Pre Basic) plan $50' title, submitting the dialog POSTs /api/plan-selection (200), shows a success toast and closes the dialog, and the main Contact form submits successfully (200), shows success toast, and resets.
critical_code_review_comments: Pricing.jsx: '(Pre Basic)' sub-label uses CSS uppercase; purely cosmetic but note that tests comparing visible text need case-insensitive matching.
server.py: load_dotenv happens after module import of os which is fine, but EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY/OWNER_EMAIL are read at import time with KeyError semantics — good for fail-fast, acceptable.
No rate-limiting / captcha on /api/plan-selection or /api/contact (public endpoints that send real emails). Consider adding simple abuse protection.
seed_data_creation: Submitted TEST_-prefixed plan_selection and contact documents to MongoDB (and emails via managed Resend) as part of integration tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Frontend: use window.__lenis.scrollTo('#pricing' or '#contact', {offset:-70, immediate:true}) to reach sections reliably. The Remedial sub-label renders uppercase via CSS — use case-insensitive text assertions. All data-testids referenced in the request exist and work.
